reason: The hypothesis transfers the SRO-strengthening mechanism, previously studied in CrCoNi and FeMnCoCrN systems, to the equimolar CoCrFeNiTi alloy, which has not been directly investigated for SRO effects. It combines evidence on SRO-induced strengthening (P4, P7) with the known lattice distortion from Ti (P10, P17) to propose a specific thermal treatment to induce SRO and test its impact on mechanical properties, filling a gap in the literature.
copied_elements: SRO increases strength and hardness (P4, P7)
SRO creates pinning points for dislocations (P4, P7, general knowledge)
Ti additions increase lattice distortion and hardness in CoCrFeNiTi (P10, P17)
